notes: INFERNO is now called 303 PULSE. Drop in your own clips, each one is analysed once on your Mac, then a wave of light runs through its depth on every kick or every bar. Fixes: clicking the 303 PULSE button several times no longer opens extra windows (that stopped the Syphon output), the servers now always close together with the app, and new installs start with a 1920 x 1080 output.

win.notes: Layout fix: with portrait (9:16) videos the preview no longer pushes the timeline off-screen. New: drag the edges of the side panels to resize them, and drag the bar above the view buttons to make the timeline taller. Double-click a handle to reset.
